finding: The same font family could otherwise appear in more than one split.
risk: Family-specific shapes could leak into evaluation and inflate performance.
decision: Split by family and forbid overlap.
action_or_limitation: Frozen assignments contain 90 families and the verified overlap count is zero.

finding: Duplicate or near-identical renders could overstate the effective sample size.
risk: Repeated pixels could make evaluation easier without adding independent evidence.
decision: Hash every file and run a strict near-duplicate screen.
action_or_limitation: No exact duplicate hash groups or suspicious near-identical pairs were found.

finding: Blank, corrupted, or missing images would make manifest counts unreliable.
risk: Unreadable inputs could produce invalid training or evaluation evidence.
decision: Open and measure every manifest image and fail quality validation on bad files.
action_or_limitation: All 3,600 paths exist and open; zero blank, corrupted, or missing images were found.

finding: Category-dependent backgrounds or effects could reveal the label.
risk: The model could learn generation shortcuts instead of typography.
decision: Use one category-independent deterministic effect schedule and audit rates.
action_or_limitation: Maximum binary effect-rate spread across categories is 0.0.

finding: Incorrect font category or licence metadata could create label or reuse errors.
risk: Wrong labels harm validity; wrong licences harm responsible reuse.
decision: Use official Google Fonts metadata and retain source, licence, Latin, and validation fields.
action_or_limitation: Selected rows passed file/render validation; per-family licence codes remain recorded.

finding: Test data could influence fitting, selection, early stopping, or the threshold.
risk: Test-guided decisions would invalidate the held-out estimate.
decision: Freeze all decisions first and evaluate the complete test split once.
action_or_limitation: Saved records state zero pre-freeze test access and no post-test tuning.

finding: Random augmentation outside training would make validation or inference nondeterministic.
risk: Changing validation/test images could bias comparison and make results unstable.
decision: Enable random augmentation only for the training transform.
action_or_limitation: Validation, test, and inference use deterministic preprocessing.

finding: Synthetic renders may not represent real screenshots, photographs, clutter, or unfamiliar designs.
risk: Real-world accuracy may be lower and confident mistakes remain possible.
decision: Keep the limitation visible and require manual testing; do not claim it is solved.
action_or_limitation: No new data or tuning is justified by this Data Gate task.
